prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "Learn how to summon, move, hide, or interact with your new companion anytime from your desktop.", "Click pet to chat or play", "Ctrl+Shift+P to show/hide"]
1: ["Desktop Display Check", "Ensuring your desktop pet can anchor cleanly onto your screen overlay."]
2: ["Custom Pet Photo Studio", "Preview lighting and contrast in real time to ensure your pet is rendered perfectly."]
3: ["Sign In & Sync Desktop Pet", "Sign in to recover your previous companions or link your new desktop pet to your account.", "Sign In with Existing Account", "Restore Previous Pet Profile"]
4: ["Press Alt + Pet to drag anywhere, or double-click to open quick actions.", "Quick Hotkey: Esc hides your pet instantly to the system tray."]
5: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "Generative assets are being compiled and calibrated for your screen resolution."]
6: ["Sign In without Losing Your Pets", "Your local pet profile and history will automatically sync and combine with your cloud account."]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Welcome your new companion home! Your official adoption registration is complete.", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
8: ["Meet Your Virtual Desk Mate", "Your pet walks along taskbars, reacts to your activity, and keeps you company."]
9: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Pick a ready-to-adopt companion personality or craft a unique custom pet."]
